name: @local/dsh-danbooru-tools
description: DSH bundle (not a standalone program) — AI-made, read-only, image-only Danbooru tools. Default (core) preset registers the 11 most-used tools: post/tag search, tag details, related tags, year-favorites artist ranking, tag-based style matching, similar artists, image-to-artist search, pixel-similarity style matching (with per-artist closest-year annotation), credentials. toolPreset="full" (or DANBOORU_TOOL_PRESET=full) adds the four rarely used extras: weighted Hot/rising artist ranking, part specialists, multi-scheme consensus and single-post lookup.
